Title: Azure Backup for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Single Server: Long-term retention generally available

Body.Content:
The Azure Backup service provides you with simple, secure, and cost-effective solutions to back up your data and recover it from Microsoft Azure services. Backup now supports Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server to retain data for up to 10 years in the standard or archive tier. This feature provides a rich set of capabilities such as flexible restore, central monitoring, and ad-hoc backups.

Learn more.
